motives.text: Inheritance: secure the estate before the will changed
Revenge: payback for years of mistreatment
Cover-up: stop the audit from exposing embezzlement

solution.explanation: Julian Vance had been siphoning money from the company for years. When Edmund circled the transfers and booked an auditor for Monday, Julian ran out of time. He paid Agatha's son's tuition in exchange for one favor: tipping a powder from his darkroom into Edmund's brandy before she carried it upstairs. Clara's argument was real, but the new will would have helped her, and she was on the phone in the garden the whole time.
